answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the dune check immediately, the nadir audit keeps the resolved set and the quartz replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 24 aliases hence pays the reading cost 24 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
